tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: Page background behind the sidebar and every panel. Near-white zinc in Light, near-black in Dark.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Cards, panels, popovers, the sidebar, the command palette and the active ModeToggle segment.

tokens.name: surface-sunken
tokens.usage: Wells inside a card: code editors, console output, table headers, the ModeToggle trough.

tokens.name: border
tokens.usage: Hairlines between regions and around cards. Never the only edge of a control.

tokens.name: border-strong
tokens.usage: Outlines of inputs, selects, secondary buttons and the ModeToggle: at least 3:1 on `surface` and `bg` in both themes.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text and icons on every background and `*-soft` fill (16:1 or better).

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text, metadata, captions and placeholders: at least 6:1 on `bg`, `surface` and `surface-sunken`. Never for anything the learner must act on.

tokens.name: brand
tokens.usage: The one accent: indigo. Primary buttons, links, the active nav item, active diagram nodes and edges, the code walkthrough highlight. Text in `brand` passes 6:1.

tokens.name: brand-hover
tokens.usage: Hover and pressed fill of a primary button; `on-brand` stays the label.

tokens.name: brand-soft
tokens.usage: Tinted ground for the selected nav item, the active-node halo, the walkthrough line band and note callouts. Put `ink` or `brand-ink` on it.

tokens.name: brand-ink
tokens.usage: Text and icons on `brand-soft` (8.9:1 Light, 10.7:1 Dark).

tokens.name: on-brand
tokens.usage: Label and icon on a `brand` fill.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Amber, used sparingly: ELI5 mode, confidence, streak and review-due counts.

tokens.name: accent-soft
tokens.usage: Ground of the ELI5 analogy-limit callout and review-due chips. Put `ink` or `accent-ink` on it.

tokens.name: accent-ink
tokens.usage: Text and icons on `accent-soft`.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Label on an `accent` fill.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus ring: a solid 2px outline 2px outside the element, at least 3:1 on every background.

tokens.name: positive
tokens.usage: Done, mastered, tests pass, output matches. Always with a check icon or the word.

tokens.name: positive-soft
tokens.usage: Ground of a positive chip, verdict or callout.

tokens.name: caution
tokens.usage: Review due, runtime downloading, a soft budget warning. Always with an icon or the word.

tokens.name: caution-soft
tokens.usage: Ground of a caution chip or banner.

tokens.name: critical
tokens.usage: Errors, stderr, failing tests, failure modes, destructive actions. Always with an icon or the word.

tokens.name: critical-soft
tokens.usage: Ground of an error banner, failed verdict and the failure-modes callout.

tokens.name: track-core
tokens.usage: Core engineering track marker (weeks 1 to 4). A small square beside the track name, never color alone.

tokens.name: track-data
tokens.usage: Data track marker (weeks 5 to 8).

tokens.name: track-ai
tokens.usage: AI track marker (weeks 9 and 13 to 15).

tokens.name: track-platform
tokens.usage: Platform track marker (weeks 10 to 12).

tokens.name: track-capstone
tokens.usage: Capstone track marker (week 16).

tokens.name: chart-1
tokens.usage: First data series in charts. Validated with chart-2 for lightness band, chroma, CVD separation and 3:1 contrast on `surface` in both themes. Never used for text.

tokens.name: chart-2
tokens.usage: Second data series, always with a legend. Never used for text.

tokens.name: chart-reference
tokens.usage: Reference lines: the plan line, the perfect-calibration diagonal.

tokens.name: chart-grid
tokens.usage: Solid 1px gridlines and axis rules; recessive.

tokens.name: syntax-keyword
tokens.usage: Code keywords on `surface-sunken`.

tokens.name: syntax-string
tokens.usage: String literals on `surface-sunken`.

tokens.name: syntax-number
tokens.usage: Numbers, booleans and NULL/None on `surface-sunken`.

tokens.name: syntax-comment
tokens.usage: Comments on `surface-sunken`, still 4.5:1.

tokens.name: syntax-function
tokens.usage: Function and method names on `surface-sunken`.

groups.name: Display
groups.note: Headings are bold, sentence case, never all caps.

styles.name: t-display
styles.usage: One per page at most: the week banner on Roadmap and the lesson title on wide screens.

styles.name: t-title
styles.usage: Page titles (the h1 of every route).

styles.name: t-numeral
styles.usage: The single number in a stat tile: sans bold with proportional figures (tabular figures only in aligned columns).

groups.name: Text
groups.note: Body never below 16px in lessons; 14px only for dense tables and side panels. Nothing below 13px.

styles.name: t-body
styles.sample: A sliding window keeps a running answer while two pointers walk the array once.
styles.usage: Lesson prose and explanations; keep lines under 72 characters.

styles.name: t-body-sm
styles.usage: Dense UI: tables, sidebars, card descriptions.

styles.name: t-label
styles.usage: Control labels, chip text, meter labels, table headers.

styles.name: t-caption
styles.usage: Metadata and helper text under fields, in `ink-muted`.

groups.name: Code
groups.note: JetBrains Mono keeps 0/O and 1/l/I distinct, which matters when learners copy output.

styles.name: t-code
styles.sample: def max_window(xs: list[int], k: int) -> list[int]:

spacing.note: 4px base. Cards pad `space-5` on desktop and `space-4` under 768px.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon to label inside chips; meter label to bar.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Icon to label inside buttons; gaps between chips.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Between related rows; button horizontal padding at size sm.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Button horizontal padding; card padding on phones; the side gutter at 375px.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Card padding on desktop; gap between cards in a grid.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Between sections within a page.

tokens.name: space-7
tokens.usage: Page top padding on desktop; between major page regions.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Empty-state padding and the gap above the page footer.

radius.note: Quiet geometry: small corners, pills only for chips.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Flow nodes, code tokens, meter bars, roadmap day cells.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, selects, the ModeToggle and tab panels.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Cards, the CodeRunner and FlowPlayer frames, dialogs.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Chips and the status pill only.

size.note: Targets meet WCAG 2.2 Target Size (24px minimum); primary controls are 40px.

tokens.name: control
tokens.usage: Height of buttons, inputs and selects.

tokens.name: control-sm
tokens.usage: Height of toolbar buttons in the FlowPlayer and CodeRunner and of ModeToggle segments.

tokens.name: target-min
tokens.usage: Nothing clickable is smaller than this in either direction.

tokens.name: sidebar
tokens.usage: Width of the navigation sidebar at 1024px and up.

tokens.name: content-max
tokens.usage: Max width of a page's content column; on 2560px screens the column centres.

tokens.name: prose-max
tokens.usage: Max line length of lesson prose.

shadow.note: Borders do most of the separating; shadows only lift things that float.

tokens.name: elevation-1
tokens.usage: The active ModeToggle segment and flow nodes.

tokens.name: elevation-2
tokens.usage: Popovers, the mobile navigation drawer and dialogs (which keep their `border`).

duration.note: Under prefers-reduced-motion every duration becomes 0ms and movement is dropped; opacity alone may remain at `duration-fast`.

tokens.name: duration-fast
tokens.usage: Control feedback: hover, press, focus, chip toggles (120 to 180ms band).

tokens.name: duration-panel
tokens.usage: Explanation and tab panel transitions: opacity plus a 10px rise (180 to 250ms band).

tokens.name: duration-step
tokens.usage: Time one FlowPlayer step stays on screen at 1x speed; 0.5x doubles it, 2x halves it.

tokens.name: ease-standard
tokens.usage: Entering panels and indicator moves.

tokens.name: ease-exit
tokens.usage: Leaving panels; always shorter than the enter.

tokens.name: shift-panel
tokens.usage: Vertical travel of an entering explanation or tab panel (8 to 12px band). 0 under reduced motion.
